title: cheirolophus junonianus var. isoplexiphyllus
intro: Cheirolophus junonianus var. isoplexiphyllus, commonly known as the 'Island Knapweed', is a rare and endemic plant species found in the Cape Verde Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Cheirolophus junonianus var. isoplexiphyllus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing digestive problems and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
